arguments.name: religionCode
arguments.description: user enters the religion code to search for and return the grid row details, including religion name

raw.name: religionCode
raw.description: user enters the religion code to search for and return the grid row details, including religion name

arguments.name: religionName
arguments.description: Religion name search text (partial allowed, example: "Christ"). Also accepts "all", "show all", "*" to fetch all records.

raw.name: religionName
raw.description: Religion name search text (partial allowed, example: "Christ"). Also accepts "all", "show all", "*" to fetch all records.

arguments.name: page
arguments.description: Page number to return (example: "6"). If omitted, defaults to "1". You may also pass "next" / "prev" with currentPage.

raw.name: page
raw.description: Page number to return (example: "6"). If omitted, defaults to "1". You may also pass "next" / "prev" with currentPage.

arguments.name: currentPage
arguments.description: Current page number (used only when page is "next" or "prev").

raw.name: currentPage
raw.description: Current page number (used only when page is "next" or "prev").

arguments.name: batchSize
arguments.description: How many records to return per response (example: "10"). If not given, it returns UI page size.

raw.name: batchSize
raw.description: How many records to return per response (example: "10"). If not given, it returns UI page size.

arguments.name: useUiPageSize
arguments.description: "true" (default) uses UI page size; "false" lets batchSize drive the size.

raw.name: useUiPageSize
raw.description: "true" (default) uses UI page size; "false" lets batchSize drive the size.

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description: "true" to fetch all pages and return all records.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description: "true" to fetch all pages and return all records.
